fa: یوسف گم‌گشته بازآید به کنعان، غم مخور
کلبهٔ احزان شود روزی گلستان، غم مخور
tr: yusof-e gomgashte bâz âyad be kan'ân, gham makhor
kolbe-ye ahzân shavad ruzi golestân, gham makhor
en: Lost Joseph will come home to Canaan, so don't be sad. One day this house of sorrow will become a rose garden, so don't be sad.
wish: Something you are waiting for is on its way. Be patient and keep hoping.

fa: صبح امید که بُد معتکف پردهٔ غیب
گو برون آی که کار شب تار آخر شد
tr: sobh-e omid ke bod mo'takef-e parde-ye gheyb
gu borun ây ke kâr-e shab-e târ âkhar shod
en: Tell the morning of hope, hiding behind the curtain, to come out: the dark night is over.
wish: Just right for Yalda: after the longest night comes the light. Brighter days are coming.

fa: دوش وقت سحر از غصه نجاتم دادند
واندر آن ظلمت شب آب حیاتم دادند
tr: dush vaght-e sahar az ghosse nejâtam dâdand
v-andar ân zolmat-e shab âb-e hayâtam dâdand
en: Last night at dawn I was set free from sadness, and in that dark night I was given the water of life.
wish: Help can come when you least expect it, even at the darkest hour.

fa: نفس باد صبا مشک‌فشان خواهد شد
عالم پیر دگرباره جوان خواهد شد
tr: nafas-e bâd-e sabâ moshk-feshân khâhad shod
âlam-e pir degarbâre javân khâhad shod
en: The morning breeze will smell sweet again, and the old world will be young once more.
wish: A fresh start is coming. Something in your life will feel new again.

fa: ستاره‌ای بدرخشید و ماه مجلس شد
دل رمیدهٔ ما را انیس و مونس شد
tr: setâre-i bedarakhshid o mâh-e majles shod
del-e ramide-ye mâ râ anis o munes shod
en: A star shone and became the moon of our gathering, and a friend to our restless heart.
wish: Someone or something new will brighten your days. A good friend may be near.

fa: سال‌ها دل طلب جام جم از ما می‌کرد
وانچه خود داشت ز بیگانه تمنا می‌کرد
tr: sâl-hâ del talab-e jâm-e jam az mâ mikard
v-ân che khod dâsht ze bigâne tamannâ mikard
en: For years my heart asked me for the magic cup of King Jamshid, begging strangers for what it already had.
wish: What you are looking for may already be with you. Look close to home.

fa: درخت دوستی بنشان که کام دل به بار آرد
نهال دشمنی برکن که رنج بی‌شمار آرد
tr: derakht-e dusti beneshân ke kâm-e del be bâr ârad
nahâl-e doshmani bar kan ke ranj-e bishomâr ârad
en: Plant the tree of friendship, because it grows what your heart wants. Pull up the seedling of hatred, because it brings endless trouble.
wish: Your wish grows through kindness. Be a good friend, and it will come back to you.

fa: هر گنج سعادت که خدا داد به حافظ
از یمن دعای شب و ورد سحری بود
tr: har ganj-e sa'âdat ke khodâ dâd be hâfez
az yomn-e do'â-ye shab o verd-e sahari bud
en: Every treasure of happiness that God gave Hafez came from his prayers at night and his words at dawn.
wish: Small efforts, every day, will bring you closer to your wish.

fa: فاش می‌گویم و از گفتهٔ خود دلشادم
بندهٔ عشقم و از هر دو جهان آزادم
tr: fâsh miguyam o az gofte-ye khod delshâdam
bande-ye eshgham o az har do jahân âzâdam
en: I say it out loud, and I'm glad I did: I belong to love, and that makes me free.
wish: Follow what you love, and say what is in your heart.

fa: دلا بسوز که سوز تو کارها بکند
نیاز نیم‌شبی دفع صد بلا بکند
tr: delâ besuz ke suz-e to kâr-hâ bekonad
niyâz-e nimshabi daf'-e sad balâ bekonad
en: Burn bright, my heart, because your fire gets things done. One wish made at midnight keeps a hundred troubles away.
wish: The wish you made tonight is strong. Keep caring about it.

fa: کمتر از ذره نه‌ای، پست مشو، مهر بورز
تا به خلوتگه خورشید رسی چرخ‌زنان
tr: kamtar az zarre nei, past masho, mehr bevarz
tâ be khalvatgah-e khorshid resi charkh-zanân
en: You are no smaller than a speck of dust, so don't think little of yourself. Love, and you will spin and dance your way up to the sun.
wish: Don't think you're too small for your wish. With love and effort, you can reach high.

fa: مژده ای دل که مسیحا نفسی می‌آید
که ز انفاس خوشش بوی کسی می‌آید
tr: mozhde ey del ke masihâ nafasi miâyad
ke ze anfâs-e khoshash bu-ye kasi miâyad
en: Good news, my heart: someone with a healing breath is coming, and their sweet breath brings the scent of someone dear.
wish: Good news is on its way, maybe from someone you love.

fa: رسید مژده که ایام غم نخواهد ماند
چنان نماند، چنین نیز هم نخواهد ماند
tr: resid mozhde ke ayyâm-e gham nakhâhad mând
chenân namând, chenin niz ham nakhâhad mând
en: The good news has come: sad days will not stay. Those days didn't last, and these won't last either.
wish: Whatever feels hard right now will pass.

fa: سحر با باد می‌گفتم حدیث آرزومندی
خطاب آمد که واثق شو به الطاف خداوندی
tr: sahar bâ bâd migoftam hadis-e ârezumandi
khetâb âmad ke vâsegh sho be altâf-e khodâvandi
en: At dawn I was telling the wind about my wish, and a voice answered: trust in God's kindness.
wish: Your wish has been heard. Trust that good things are coming.

fa: بر سر آنم که گر ز دست برآید
دست به کاری زنم که غصه سرآید
tr: bar sar-e ânam ke gar ze dast bar âyad
dast be kâri zanam ke ghosse sar âyad
en: I have made up my mind: if I can, I will do something that brings sadness to an end.
wish: Your wish needs you too. Take the first small step.

fa: ز کوی یار می‌آید نسیم باد نوروزی
از این باد ار مدد خواهی، چراغ دل برافروزی
tr: ze kuy-e yâr miâyad nasim-e bâd-e nowruzi
az in bâd ar madad khâhi, cherâgh-e del barafruzi
en: The breeze of Nowruz is blowing from a friend's street. Ask this breeze for help, and you will light the lamp of your heart.
wish: Spring is on its way, and so is your wish. It will light up like a lamp.

fa: شکرشکن شوند همه طوطیان هند
زین قند پارسی که به بنگاله می‌رود
tr: shekar-shekan shavand hame tutiyân-e hend
zin ghand-e pârsi ke be bangâle miravad
en: All the parrots of India will be cracking sugar, thanks to this sweet Persian that is travelling to Bengal.
wish: Hafez is saying how sweet Persian is. Keep learning it, and share it with the people you love.

fa: چو بشنوی سخن اهل دل، مگو که خطاست
سخن‌شناس نه‌ای، جان من، خطا این‌جاست
tr: cho beshnavi sokhan-e ahl-e del, magu ke khatâst
sokhan-shenâs nei, jân-e man, khatâ injâst
en: When you hear wise words from the heart, don't say they are wrong. My dear, if you don't understand them, that is where the mistake is.
wish: Listen to the people who love you, even when their advice is hard to hear.

fa: هرگز نمیرد آن که دلش زنده شد به عشق
ثبت است بر جریدهٔ عالم دوام ما
tr: hargez namirad ân ke delash zende shod be eshgh
sabt ast bar jaride-ye âlam davâm-e mâ
en: Whoever's heart comes alive with love never dies. Our lasting is written in the book of the world.
wish: What you do with love lasts. It will be remembered.

fa: گفتم غم تو دارم، گفتا غمت سرآید
گفتم که ماه من شو، گفتا اگر برآید
tr: goftam gham-e to dâram, goftâ ghamat sar âyad
goftam ke mâh-e man sho, goftâ agar bar âyad
en: I said, "I miss you." You said, "Your sadness will end." I said, "Be my moon." You said, "If it rises."
wish: Your worry will end soon, and your wish can come true when the time is right.
